# Lear Lily, stap bi stap

Walcome! Ilka tutorial stairts frae scart an bigs the same wee thing — an accessible, styled form — in aboot 10 minutes, sae ye can compare frameworks apples-tae-apples. Then gang deeper wi theming an uiser preferences.

## Afore ye stairt

Ye need surprisingly little:

- **For the HTML tutorial** — juist a browser an a text editor. That's the hail toolkit.
- **For Svelte, React, Vue, Angular, or Nunjucks** — [git](https://git-scm.com/), Node 26, an pnpm 10 or later.
- **For Blazor** — git an the [.NET SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/) 11 or later.

New tae headless components? Ye're in the richt place — ilka tutorial explains whit's happenin as ye gang, an ilka step shaws the exact code tae copy.

## Fower steps frae zero tae shipped

1. **Yer first component** (~5 minutes) — pick yer framework ablow, git the code, an render a Button.
2. **Compose an style** (~5 minutes) — big a labelled form an style it against the kebab-case class hooks (pairt o ilka framework tutorial).
3. **Theme it** (~15 minutes) — swap yer haund-written CSS for ane o the 63 ready-made themes, then let uisers switch at runtime: [theming tutorial](https://lilydesignsystem.com/sco-gb/tutorials/theming/).
4. **Respect preferences** (~15 minutes) — add leid an text-size selection wi the preference helpers: [helpers tutorial](https://lilydesignsystem.com/sco-gb/tutorials/helpers/).

## Efter the tutorials

- Brouse the [component catalog](https://lilydesignsystem.com/components/) — ilka component documents its props, ARIA contract, an keyboard behaviour.
- Clone an [example app](https://lilydesignsystem.com/sco-gb/examples/) tae see aw 608 components styled an wirkin thegither — the CSS targets the same class hooks ye juist uised, sae copy onie pairt o it intae yer project an adjust it as ye wish.
- Questions? The [help page](https://lilydesignsystem.com/sco-gb/help/) haes answers, an FAQ, an weys tae reach a freendly human. An if a tutorial could be clearer, [tell us](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem) — we'll gladly improve it.
